body:
Yes it should be readable, it seems from the people I follow that are doing a lot of CSS that postprocessors are the way to go for modern CSS stacks.

They are the babel of CSS: write real CSS using latest CSS specs and compile to CSS.

So you won't have to re-learn CSS when new CSS features are released to browsers, you already know them.

I agree it can be a shift from being good at SASS.
